title: In Northampton, Sandra Riley waited 45 years for a football team, then helped build one

posts.facebook:
Sandra Riley wanted to play football at 11. There was nowhere for girls. At 56 she had a team of 30.

Sandra Riley of Hardingstone, Northampton, took up walking football after seeing it on television in 2018 and helped grow Northampton Town Ladies Walking Football Team to 30 members. What the game is, what the evidence says, and how to find a first session in the UK or the US.

The game you were never offered is being played, at walking pace, somewhere near you this week.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/connect/sandra-riley-walking-football-northampton-56/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
